keySentence: Mother gave him camomile tea and tucked him in.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mother made warm tea. Peter drank the tea. She covered him with a blanket. Mother gave him camomile tea and tucked him in.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Peter was lying in bed still feeling very sick. Mother Rabbit went to the kitchen to make something special. She brought a warm cup of camomile tea to his bedside. Peter sipped the tea slowly and his tummy felt better. Mother gave him camomile tea and tucked him in lovingly. Peter fell asleep feeling safe in his mother's care.
facts.Word cards: mother = 엄마 / bed = 침대 / camomile tea = 카모마일 차 🆕 / care = 돌봄 🆕 / better = 나아진 🆕
